result.reason: The added language otherwise reaches the preferred position for termination: up to six months of assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and written deletion certification. However, it does not apply upon expiry, as required. There is also a minor ambiguity because subsection (iv) permits immediate destruction of Confidential Information without expressly carving out Customer Data subject to subsection (v). The amendment is otherwise targeted and preserves the bilateral confidentiality-return obligation.
